movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms joined with neighboring dancers in a W-position
movement_profile.formation_and_space: One or more open circles moving in a line structure
movement_profile.partnering: Group connection via joined hands in W-position; no individual partnering
movement_profile.posture: Upright posture with arms joined in a high W-position
movement_profile.tempo_feel: Asymmetrical 7/8 pulse with a slow initial beat followed by two quick beats
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Dropping the W-position hand hold or miscounting the asymmetrical 7/8 slow-quick-quick meter

music_profile.sound_description: A traditional Bulgarian melody in asymmetrical 7/8 time. The rhythm is characterized by a distinct slow-quick-quick pulse underlying a strophic narrative folk vocal line.
music_profile.vocal_style: Traditional Bulgarian folk vocal style singing a narrative story

basic_steps: Form an open circle facing inward or along the line of direction.
Join hands with neighboring dancers and raise arms into a W-position at shoulder height.
Step according to the 7/8 meter following the slow-quick-quick (SQQ) rhythmic pulse.
teaching.level_notes: Accessible for beginners learning Balkan asymmetrical meters due to the clear slow-quick-quick 7/8 division and supportive W-position arm hold.
